title: ROS 2 client libraries (rclcpp, rclpy)
keywords: client library rclcpp rclpy rcl cpp python language
text: Nodes are written with a client library: rclcpp for C++ and rclpy for Python, both built on rcl and the RMW layer. They share the same concepts (nodes, publishers, executors, QoS), so a C++ node and a Python node interoperate when names, types and QoS match. A difference in behavior between them is usually a different default, such as the QoS profile or the executor, not an incompatibility on the wire.
